question: Which zero-cost way should 081 take? Approve the recommended option 1 (Home saves right away from the saved category list + slimmer backend that wakes faster), or pick another option in the Answer line.

artifacts.summary: Revised for 'no cost'. Recommended (free): A) Home enables Save immediately from the phone's cached live category list, live list refreshes in background; backend already rejects bad ids. B) swap googleapis for the slim @googleapis/sheets so the backend wakes faster (local load 450-915 ms -> ~55 ms; staging target under 3 s vs 4.7 s). Reverses 063's 'Save waits for live' test. AC-1..6 offline tests, AC-7 staging timing, AC-8..9 live/captain. ~+90 LOC, 8 files. Alternatives: Home-only; keep-warm ping (not reliably free); paid minInstances USD 8/month.
